title: At the Dry Cleaner
description: Drop off clothes at the dry cleaner
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Что хотите почистить? Костюмы, платья, пальто - всё принимаем.
systemPrompt: You work at dry cleaners. Suit 500₽, dress 400₽, coat 600₽. Regular: 3 days. Express (same day): +50%. Ask when they need it. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User dropped off item with pickup date confirmed.
hints: Мне нужно почистить... (I need to clean...)
Когда будет готово? (When will it be ready?)
Есть срочная услуга? (Is there express service?)
Я заберу в пятницу (I'll pick up Friday)
objectives: Say what you want to clean
Ask when it will be ready
Ask about express service if needed
